title: NKA.gg huss volley script BEST
features:
nka.gg | Huss Valley
A script for huss volley, featuring Runner and Catcher automation in a custom purple interface.

Runner Features
Auto Run with threat avoidance and target prediction.
Auto Collect Gems with configurable collection settings.
Auto Revive Players, including an option to prioritize revives over gems.
Auto Dash and emergency safe-zone navigation.
Adjustable movement speed and smooth direction changes.
Catcher Features
Auto Chase with predictive targeting.
Auto Tackle and Auto Melee with adjustable ranges.
Choose between Smart, Tackle First, and Melee First attack priorities.
Configurable movement speed, turning, and target following.
Rewards & Utilities
Auto Spin Wheel with configurable delays and minimum credits.
Auto Claim Journey Rewards.
Auto Map Vote with a preferred map selection.
Camera-follow controls, goal indicators, threat visuals, and hitbox helpers.
Anti-idle option and a rejoin button.
Custom nka.gg Interface
Purple-themed menu with organized tabs and two-column settings.
Adjustable UI scale, transparency, and menu toggle key.
Save, load, delete, and automatically load configurations.
FPS watermark, notifications, and a debug panel.
Default menu key: RightShift
Community & updates: discord.gg/nkagghub
